title: Zone window bounds
statement: For a zone index $i$ and an integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le 2$ times the capacity of zone $i$, both $2b_i+2+p$ and $-(2b_i)-1-p$ lie in the integer interval from $-(2b_{i+1}+2)$ to $2b_{i+1}+2$, where $b_j$ denotes the base of zone $j$.
hypotheses_covered: An integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le 2$ times the capacity of zone $i$
